history.summary: Arulmigu Mangalambikai Udanurai Magalingeswarar Temple is a Shiva shrine in Dharmapuri city whose consort is Mangalambikai; it is described by a temple directory as a notable Shiva temple of the city. (flag) No published history, inscription record or built-date source was found - dynasty, period and age are all unverified. (flag) Identity is uncertain: nearby listings name similar shrines 'Mahalingeshwarar Temple' (Dharmapuri, reported at approx 12.1304 N, 78.1575 E, daily 5:30 AM-8:30 PM) and 'Mallingeshwar Temple' (approx 12.1337 N, 78.1608 E), which may be the same or different shrines; the coordinates used here are approximate and should be field-verified. (flag) CSV 'state' column wrongly reads 'Dharmapuri' - corrected to Tamil Nadu. (flag) media left empty: image searches returned no verified photograph of this temple.

name: Magalingeswarar Temple
town_description: Dharmapuri is a city in northwestern Tamil Nadu and headquarters of Dharmapuri district, set on the Baramahal plateau along National Highway 44 between Bengaluru and Salem. Traditionally called Thagadur, it was a stronghold of the Athiyaman chieftains and later saw Chola, Hoysala, Vijayanagara and Mysore rule; it is known for its temples, silk weaving and mango orchards.

travel.airport: Salem Airport (IXM, ~75 km) or Kempegowda International Airport, Bengaluru (~135 km)
travel.railway: Dharmapuri Junction (DPJ), ~2 km from the town centre
travel.road: On NH 44 (Bangalore-Salem highway); connected by state and private buses to Bengaluru, Salem and Krishnagiri.

visitor_information.opening_hours: Reported as 5:30 AM-8:30 PM daily by one directory listing (verify)
